title: Process Transformation & Technology Specialist - FAPS
description:
Process Transformation & Technology Specialist - Finance and Procurement Business Operations- Transformation 
 Function 
Finance & Procurement Business Operations 
 Scope 
Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Intercompany, Master Data Management, Procurement Operations and Service desk Transformation.

 Position Summary 
Process Transformation & Technology Specialist plays a critical role in driving operational excellence and transformation initiatives across global Finance and Procurement functions. The role is responsible for identifying, designing, and implementing process improvements, automation solutions, and operating model enhancements that improve efficiency, controls, stakeholder experience, and business outcomes.
Working across Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Intercompany, Master Data, and Procurement processes, this position partners closely with Finance and Procurement Operations, Shared Services, Controllership, Business Teams, and Digital Technology organizations to translate strategic priorities into scalable, measurable solutions.

 Key Responsibilities 
 Transformation & Process Excellence 
 Lead and deliver transformation initiatives across AP, AR, Intercompany, Master Data, and Procurement in alignment with the broader Finance Transformation roadmap. Analyze current-state processes, identify root causes and inefficiencies, and design future-state solutions that improve service delivery, controls, compliance, and efficiency. Drive process standardization, simplification, and harmonization across regions while balancing local regulatory and business requirements. Develop business cases, process maps, operating procedures, requirements documentation, test scenarios, and deployment plans. Identify opportunities to improve transaction quality, cycle times, working capital performance, and overall process effectiveness. Support implementation activities including user acceptance testing, defect resolution, cutover planning, and post-go-live stabilization. 
 Digital Transformation & Automation 
 Partner with technology teams and process owners to evaluate, prioritize, and deploy automation and workflow solutions. Leverage process mining, process intelligence, and analytics capabilities to identify improvement opportunities and measure outcomes. Support implementation of digital technologies including SAP Signavio, SAP Build Process Automation, Microsoft Power Platform, AI-enabled tools, and workflow technologies. Drive adoption of analytics and reporting solutions using Power BI, Databricks, and related platforms. Explore and implement practical AI and machine learning use cases to improve knowledge management, decision support, transaction processing, and operational efficiency. Ensure automation solutions incorporate appropriate governance, controls, auditability, data quality standards, and ownership frameworks. 
 Stakeholder Management & Change Leadership 
 Facilitate workshops, process reviews, design sessions, and governance forums with key stakeholders. Build alignment across Finance, Procurement, Shared Services, Technology, and Business teams to support successful transformation outcomes. Develop communication plans, training materials, operating procedures, and change management strategies. Manage risks, dependencies, and escalations while ensuring stakeholder engagement and adoption. Promote a culture of continuous improvement through Lean, Six Sigma, and best-practice methodologies. 
 Governance, Controls & Performance Management 
 Maintain project governance artifacts including project plans, risk registers, issue logs, action trackers, dependency logs, and benefits realization frameworks. Provide regular executive-level reporting on delivery progress, milestones, risks, adoption, and value realization. Ensure solutions remain compliant with finance policies, internal controls, audit requirements, regulatory obligations, and governance standards. Monitor post-implementation performance and drive corrective actions when expected outcomes are not achieved. Contribute to the development of transformation playbooks, methodologies, standards, and reusable assets. 
 Required Qualifications 
 Education 
 Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, or a related discipline. MBA, Master's degree, PGDBA, or equivalent postgraduate qualification preferred. Lean Six Sigma, PMP, Agile, Change Management, or other transformation certifications preferred. 
 Professional Experience 
 8+ years of experience in Finance Operations, Shared Services, Global Business Services (GBS), Procurement Operations, or Management Consulting. Minimum 3 years of experience leading or supporting finance transformation, process improvement, automation, or operating model initiatives. Demonstrated experience managing cross-functional projects across multiple business units, regions, or stakeholder groups. Strong knowledge of Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Intercompany Accounting, Master Data, and Procurement processes. Experience with SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA environments. Practical experience in process mapping, business requirements definition, operating model design, and implementation support. Experience working with reporting and analytics tools such as Power BI, Excel, Databricks, or equivalent platforms. Automotive, manufacturing, or OEM industry experience strongly preferred. 
 Core Competencies 
 Business Process Expertise 
 Strong understanding of end-to-end AP, AR, Intercompany, Procurement, and Master Data processes. Knowledge of operational KPIs, service levels, controls, compliance requirements, and financial performance drivers. Transformation & Continuous Improvement 
 Proven ability to convert business challenges into scalable process, technology, and operating model solutions. Expertise in process reengineering, root-cause analysis, and continuous improvement methodologies. Data & Analytics 
 Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and measure business outcomes. Ability to develop insights that drive operational improvements and decision-making. Relationship Management 
 Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence without direct authority. Excellent communication and presentation capabilities across operational and leadership audiences. Governance & Controls 
 Understanding of internal controls, audit frameworks, risk management, segregation of duties, and compliance requirements. Ability to ensure transformation initiatives balance efficiency gains with a strong control environment. 
 Success Measures 
 Success in this role will be measured through: 
 Successful delivery of transformation initiatives within agreed scope, timeline, and budget. Improvements in process efficiency, automation adoption, cycle times, and service quality. Increased straight-through processing and reduction of manual effort, exceptions, and rework. Improvements in working capital metrics including invoice cycle times, DSO, aging, unapplied cash, and intercompany reconciliation performance. Improved master data quality, governance adherence, and turnaround times. Sustainable governance, controls compliance, and audit readiness. 
 Preferred Technology Landscape 
 SAP S/4HANA and SAP ECC SAP Signavio (Process Mining, Process Insights, Process Modeling) SAP Build Process Automation (SAP BTP) SAP MDG and SAP GRC SAP Joule / SAP Business AI Microsoft Power Platform (Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate) Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio Databricks KNIME Analytics Platform OpenText Workflow Solutions Intercompany Accounting Systems (IAS) SharePoint and Enterprise Collaboration Platforms

Key Skills: Financial Transformation,Business Transformation,Intercompany,Procurement,Operational Excellence,Process Improvement,Accounts Receivable,Master Data

Summarise data weekly for the budget dashboards and process reclass entries wherever required. Annual fee: Track & manage annual alliance fee records and process journal entries for codes received. Manage monthly recurring entries and year end accruals. GDS budget Analysis / updates: Manage and update GDS headcount file with latest rates, headcount status, new roles and hiring/exit status. Reconcile general chargeback code to regularly assess and report available balance for GDS cost management. Provide details to stakeholders on required fees to manage GDS costs. Manage GDS invoice records, billing inventory, and assist in periodic invoicing activities. Review & reconcile invoices and highlight any discrepancies in the GDS invoices. Operations: Provide Operational support/cost improvement studies to enable effective management to improve operations and increase the efficiency of resources/processes. Provide headcount reports to manage distribution lists on a monthly basis. Share invoices with the processing team and track payment status on a weekly basis. Coordinate with functional teams for collecting data. Investments: Track all GTM invoices, compare the budget allocation, analyse the available budget, send details to stakeholders for required approvals and connect weekly with GTM team. Connect with GDS team on the open items, provide support on the invoicing process, offer any other finance support on the new programs / activities. Reconcile and summarise investment data for quarterly reporting and dashboard. Adhoc Analysis / Reports: Ad-hoc reporting/operations/admin support for initiatives/ projects as required. Study, analyse, and understand business requirements in the context of preparing executive summaries, reports, key takeaways, and visualizations.. Automation of reports wherever possible and provide inputs for process improvement, building efficiencies, and standardization Process Improvement and Standardization: Define processes and lead/support the design of processes and roles leveraging best-in-class practices and enabling technologies, to ensure optimum and consistent performance. Support delivery of upstream operations digital solutions by helping define and validate data and workflow needs, including combining inputs from field planning, operations, and finance for performance optimization Validate analytics outputs, dashboards, and insights against operational realism and operating philosophies; drive iterative improvements with product/data teams. Engineering Degree in Chemical / Mechanical / Instrumentation / Petroleum disciplines MBA Experience from/with IOC environments and particularly Exxon Mobil / Shell / BP-type operating models.
